1.consolidated_definition: Traje civil de los sacerdotes que se lleva con alzacuello y que sustituye la sotana. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Los clérigos vestirán traje eclesiástico, sotana o clergyman (pantalón y chaqueta) de color oscuro (negro, azul marino, gris) y cuello romano o camisa clerical del color correspondiente, especialmente en el ejercicio del ministerio o en cualquier actuación pública (Conferencia Episcopal Puertorriqueña, 13-05-87)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Clerical attire of priests that is worn with a clerical collar and serves as a substitute for the cassock. Raw Anglicism, relatively infrequent. Clergymen will wear dark-colored (black, navy blue, gray) ecclesiastical attire, cassock or clergyman's suit (pants and jacket), along with a Roman collar or clerical shirt of the corresponding color, especially in the exercise of ministry or any public performance (Puerto Rican Episcopal Conference, 13-05-87).
